ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
When $\angle FMD=90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle F=\angle B, \angle FMD=\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \triangle FDM\sim \triangle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \frac{DF}{AB}=\frac{DM}{AC}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{5}{10}=\frac{DM}{6}$,\\
$\therefore DM=3$,\\
$\therefore CM=CD-DM=2$,\\
$\because \angle ECM=\angle B$,\\
$\therefore \angle CME=\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \triangle CEM\sim \triangle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \frac{CE}{AB}=\frac{CM}{BC}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{CE}{10}=\frac{2}{8}$,\\
$\therefore CE=\frac{5}{2}$,\\
$\therefore BE=\frac{11}{2}$;\\

$\because \angle F=\angle BCD, \angle FMD=\angle CME$,\\
$\therefore \angle CEM=\angle FDM=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle FED=\angle BED=45^\circ$,\\
Construct $DH\perp BC$ at $H$,\\

$\therefore \frac{DB}{BA}=\frac{DH}{AC}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{5}{10}=\frac{DH}{6}$,\\
$\therefore DH=3, BH=4$,\\
$\therefore EH=DH=3$,\\
$\therefore BE=3+4=7$.\\

raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
When $\angle FMD=90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle F=\angle B, \angle FMD=\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \triangle FDM\sim \triangle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \frac{DF}{AB}=\frac{DM}{AC}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{5}{10}=\frac{DM}{6}$,\\
$\therefore DM=3$,\\
$\therefore CM=CD-DM=2$,\\
$\because \angle ECM=\angle B$,\\
$\therefore \angle CME=\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \triangle CEM\sim \triangle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \frac{CE}{AB}=\frac{CM}{BC}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{CE}{10}=\frac{2}{8}$,\\
$\therefore CE=\frac{5}{2}$,\\
$\therefore BE=\frac{11}{2}$;\\
When $\angle FDM=90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle F=\angle BCD, \angle FMD=\angle CME$,\\
$\therefore \angle CEM=\angle FDM=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle FED=\angle BED=45^\circ$,\\
Construct $DH\perp BC$ at $H$,\\
Then $\triangle BDH\sim \triangle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \frac{DB}{BA}=\frac{DH}{AC}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{5}{10}=\frac{DH}{6}$,\\
$\therefore DH=3, BH=4$,\\
